name: Beloved
overview: The term 'Beloved' in Scripture reveals a profound truth about God's affectionate and chosen relationship with His people. At the Transfiguration, God declares Jesus as His beloved Son, highlighting divine pleasure and authority in Him. Similarly, believers are called 'beloved of God,' emphasizing their identity as saints who receive grace and peace through Christ. This beloved status also calls Christians to reflect God's character by embodying mercy, kindness, humility, and patience as His holy and chosen ones.
